content.title: USA Rare Earth Falls After Deal Approval. What’s Next for the Trade.
content.summary: USA Rare Earth  stock fell on Wednesday despite the company announcing U.K. approval for its purchase of the manufacturer Less Common Metals.  USA Rare Earth stock traded as high as $18.56 but closed at $16.92, down 4.8%, while the  and  gained 0.1% and 0.7%, respectively.  The company, which is developing a rare-earth mine in Texas, agreed to buy Less Common Metals, a U.K.-based manufacturer of specialized rare-earth metals and alloys, for $100 million and 6.74 million shares in September.

content.title: MP Materials Earnings Are in Focus as Rare-Earth Rally Fades
content.summary: The past month has been wild for  MP Materials  and other rare-earth stocks.  Coming into Thursday trading, shares of MP Materials, the largest rare- earth producer in the Western Hemisphere, and aspiring rare earth miners  Ramaco  Resource and  USA Rare Earth  s were down an average of 34% over the past month.  MP stock, however, was up a solid 3.3% in premarket trading on Thursday, only to close down 5.4% at $51.95.

content.title: MP Materials Stock Slumps After Trump Says China Rare-Earth Threat Is ‘Completely Gone.’ The Trade Isn’t.
content.summary: Rare-earth stocks fell again on Monday as investors unwound bets tied to the fear of Chinese export restrictions.  MP Materials  the largest rare-earth company in the Western Hemisphere, and aspiring rare-earth miners  USA Rare Earth  and  Ramaco Resources  all took hits to their shares.  MP stock dropped 8.6% on Monday.

content.title: Amazon AWS & Cipher strike deal, Beyond Meat delays Q3 results
content.description:
Yahoo Finance anchor Julie Hyman tracks Monday's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute.

Cipher Mining (CIFR) stock is climbing after the company announced a deal with Amazon (AMZN) Web Services (AWS).

Rare earth stocks, including MP Materials (MP), USA Rare Earth (USAR), and Ramaco Resources (METC), are falling after President Trump said Chinese supply of the materials is no longer under threat.

Beyond Meat (BYND) stock is sinking as the company delays its third quarter earnings results.

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.
